title: numeric package: the sparse solver out of quadlayout, plus exact predicates, UnionFind and the Dijkstra core
description:
Repo plan phase 1.3 (moves only; deleting the duplicate copies is a phase 4 ticket). geometry/mesh/quadlayout/solver (37 files: chol/accelerate, chol/paradiso, matrix, ordering, system) is general linear algebra already imported by platform/gl/{Platform,Headless,Lwjgl,Web}Platform, canvas/IxdarWindow and the SeamlessDiagnosis endpoint. Move it to numeric/sparse. Move seamless/exact/ExactArithmetic and embedding/ExactBarycentricOrient to numeric/exact; geometry/mesh/data/UnionFind and data/paths/Dijkstra (and ShortestPathForest if it is the generic part) to numeric/graph.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. platform/ no longer imports geometry/mesh/quadlayout.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. Quad-suite fingerprints on the standard models are byte-identical to master.
4. Launch entry and screenshot of a quad-layout scene.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test.
2. The quad-suite fingerprint run used by recent seamless tickets, before and after.
changes-made: Moved geometry/mesh/quadlayout/solver (33 files, chol/accelerate, chol/paradiso, matrix, ordering, system, both package-infos) to ixdar.numeric.sparse; ExactArithmetic plus its return type IrrefResult and ExactBarycentricOrient to ixdar.numeric.exact; UnionFind, Dijkstra and ShortestPathForest to ixdar.numeric.graph. New package-info for numeric, numeric.exact, numeric.graph; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated by the compile. No class renamed, no logic touched; imports updated in 41 importers and 10 same-package users. No pom, TeaVM or string reference named the old packages (backends are reached only through Platform.nativeCholeskyBackend). platform/ no longer imports quadlayout.

Verification: mvn test 521 run, 0 failures. Quad suite (tmp/quad-suite/run_suite.py) before (tmp/quad-suite/mesh-57-before, unchanged dsl-49 stack) vs after (mesh-57-after): 14/14 MATCH, signature and screenshot sha256 identical; after-run screenshots also identical to master-599d7773. Every mesh other than the 4 known load failures reports pipeline-incomplete on both runs because the stack base no longer prints the [quad-layout] stage-timing lines run_suite.py looks for; that is the base, not this change. Generated Scene/MeshNode/Command/AutomationRoute/Geometry registries byte-identical to dsl-49's; automation_routes.json and the node catalog unchanged. All 21 CanvasSceneMap scenes launch headless (run-scene ok). Launch entry 'MESH-57: quad-layout'; wt done passed.
